summaries.en: FreeDomain is an open-source platform that provides free domain registration services, addressing the barrier of domain costs for developers and small projects. Built primarily with HTML, it offers a straightforward web interface for users to claim and manage domains without financial commitment. You can deploy it locally to create custom domain services or integrate its domain management logic into your own applications for testing and development purposes.
summaries.zh: FreeDomain 是一个开源域名注册平台，旨在为开发者和初创项目提供免费的域名服务，降低技术项目的入门门槛。该项目采用 HTML 构建简洁的网页界面，用户可直接在线申请和管理域名，无需支付费用。开发者可将其部署到本地环境，搭建个性化的域名分发系统，或借鉴其域名分配逻辑集成到自己的应用中，非常适合用于项目演示、测试环境搭建或教育用途的实践探索。

summaries.en: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to costly stock market platforms, offering real-time price tracking, personalized alerts, and detailed company insights. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, it leverages modern web technologies like Tailwind CSS and shadcn-ui for a responsive UI, while Inngest handles background jobs efficiently. Developers can self-host or extend it for custom financial dashboards, making professional-grade market data accessible to everyone.
summaries.zh: OpenStock 是一个开源股票市场平台，旨在替代昂贵的商业服务。它提供实时价格追踪、个性化提醒和公司深度分析，所有功能免费开放。技术上，项目基于 Next.js 和 TypeScript，使用 Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn-ui 构建响应式界面，并通过 Inngest 高效处理后台任务。其设计强调可扩展性，开发者可以轻松自托管或定制，例如添加自定义指标或集成其他数据源。对于想学习现代全栈开发或构建金融工具的人来说，这是一个极佳的参考项目。

summaries.en: ppf-contact-solver is a physics-based contact solver for simulating interactions among shells, solids, and rods. It uses a novel incremental potential contact (IPC) method with a smoothed barrier function to prevent intersections, ensuring robust, penetration-free results. Technically, it employs a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation solved via a projected Newton method. You can integrate it into cloth, soft body, or rod simulations for realistic collision handling, and extend it to complex scenes like fabric draping or cable entanglement.
summaries.zh: ppf-contact-solver是一个用于物理仿真的接触求解器，专门处理壳、实体和杆之间的相互作用。它采用增量势接触（IPC）方法，通过平滑障碍函数防止穿透，确保结果鲁棒且无交叉。技术上，它将接触问题建模为非线性互补问题，并用投影牛顿法高效求解。你可以将其集成到布料、软体或绳索的仿真中，实现逼真的碰撞响应，例如模拟布料垂落、电缆缠绕等复杂场景。该工具为需要精确接触处理的物理模拟提供了可靠基础。

summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
